programme.title: షవర్స్ ఆఫ్ బ్లెస్సింగ్స్ - విషెస్
programme.desc: వ్యాఖ్యాత హృదయపూర్వక పుట్టినరోజు, వార్షికోత్సవ శుభాకాంక్షలతో వివిధ గాయకులు,సంగీతకారులు శ్రావ్యమైన పాటలను ప్రదర్శిస్తారు.

programme.title: వెకేట్
programme.desc: ఒక పాస్టర్ మతం, మతపరమైన విషయాలను, లెన్స్, క్రీస్తు బోధనల దృక్కోణంపై చర్చిస్తాడు, మంచి జీవితాన్ని అనుసరించమని కోరతారు.

programme.title: పి జి స్టీఫెన్ పాల్
programme.desc: పి జె స్టీఫెన్ పాల్ పవిత్ర బైబిలులోని శ్లోకాలను చదువుతూ ప్రసంగించి, అనుచరులను నీతివంతమైన జీవితం గడపమని ప్రోత్సహిస్తారు.

programme.title: సిస్టర్ జాయ్ చెరియన్
programme.desc: సిస్టర్ జాయ్ చెరియన్ విశ్వాసకులకు దేవుని కృప, జీవితంలో బైబిలు బోధనలను అనుసరించవలసిన ప్రాముఖ్యత గురించి వివరిస్తారు.

programme.title: ఓం భీమ్ బుష్
programme.desc: నిధిని వేయడానికి ఒక గ్రామానికి వచ్చిన ముగ్గురు శాస్త్రవేత్తలు పాడుబడిన బంగళాలో చేతబడి చూసినప్పుడు పరిస్థితులు మారతాయి.

Right away it becomes obvious that Felix's uptight, neat-freak ways are at odds with his habits, so Oscar worries he has made an enormous mistake, but together they decide that -- whatever their differences -- they can help each other move on from their divorces, make the living arrangement work and, possibly, learn a little more about themselves in the process.

Right away it becomes obvious that Felix's uptight, neat-freak ways are at odds with his habits, so Oscar worries he has made an enormous mistake, but together they decide that -- whatever their differences -- they can help each other move on from their divorces, make the living arrangement work and, possibly, learn a little more about themselves in the process.

programme.title: Vishal In Laatti Charge
programme.desc: A police constable lands in grave danger when he gets trapped by a dangerous gang in a building with his sick son. He must strive to defeat the villains and escape to safety.

programme.title: Ram Ki Jung
programme.desc: Ram does not believe in everlasting love and this ideology does not go down well with Jaanu. When Abhishek, a police officer, asks him the reason, he tells him about Rooba, his former lover.

programme.title: Rudra Suryavanshi
programme.desc: Gunasingam, a rich farmer, lives a humble life with his family. However, things take a turn when he falls in love with the most beautiful woman in the village.

programme.title: Dear Ghilli
programme.desc: Ghilli, a dog, navigates through several challenges and experiences with his owner as both of them attempt to win the hearts of their lovers.

programme.title: Striker
programme.desc: Life changes for Surya, a young boy from Mumbai when he returns home following communal riots. He goes on to become a carrom champion and is pursued by Jaleel, head of a betting syndicate.

programme.title: Hanuman Da' Damdaar
programme.desc: A young boy, sets out to make his father proud by embarking on a series of jungle adventure which leads him to metamorphose in to Hanuman.

programme.title: Seetharama Kalyana
programme.desc: Arya is an altruistic individual who constantly sacrifices his happiness for his loved ones. Consequently, his romance with innocent Geetha faces severe hurdles.

programme.title: Tiger Nageswara Rao
programme.desc: In the 1970s, a daring thief named Tiger Nageswara Rao becomes a legend due to the heists he masterminds and the ingenious ways by which he evades the police.

programme.title: Main hoon Surya Singham 2
programme.desc: An undercover police officer works in a school in Tamil Nadu and tries to put an end to the criminal activities of two criminals who rule the area.

programme.title: Power Unlimited 2
programme.desc: Karthikeya, a man who is devoted to his family, faces a huge challenge as his violent and turbulent past begins to resurface.

programme.title: Taqdeer
programme.desc: Soon after Avinash manages to get the phone number of his childhood love Priya, his phone gets stolen by a gangster. So, he sets out on a dangerous chase in order to reconcile with his lover.

programme.title: Yudh Ek Jung
programme.desc: Chandu, a supermarket employee, encounters trouble after he decides to help Indu, an aspiring actor. But when he gets embroiled in a murder case, a dark secret from his past resurfaces.
